description.value:
Duration constant

Afflicted you raise last twice as long before collapsing. This does not change how many you may control at once, and an Afflicted destroyed before its time still stays destroyed.

cinderfall.incomplete: This clause is an ongoing effect targeting a different creature's roll/HP/condition/behavior, sourced from the holder's own passive (P-CROSSCREATURE), with no selector anywhere in pf2e-source for one actor's rule element to reach into a separate actor on an ongoing basis. Afflicted is this class's minion subsystem: a raise-cap, a collapse timer, and (at level 18) a shared cross-actor Resonance pool. pf2e's schema has no generic "max controlled minions" field, no "minion lifespan" field, and no mechanism for one actor's rule element to modify a different actor's stats on an ongoing basis. No "minion lifespan" field exists anywhere in pf2e's schema to double.
